---
name: Feature request
about: A component or capability finixui should have
labels: enhancement
---

**What's the pattern?**
Link a product or screenshot that does it well (free/open sources only —
finixui never ports code from restricted-license libraries).

**Which module should own it?**
Core primitives, an existing industry module, or a new one?

**Would you use it in a real project?**
Context on the stack (Rails/Django/Laravel/Go/…) helps prioritize.
